ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Visionary
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Emphasize long-term strategic value and future-state vision for cloud optimization.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Analytical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Focus on quantifiable metrics, analytical insights, and evidence-based recommendations.

ToneOptions.Label: Action-Oriented & Decisive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Drive immediate understanding and prompt decision-making on cloud waste remediation.

ToneOptions.Label: Confident & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Project strong confidence in the solution's technical capabilities and impact.

GoalOptions.Label: Secure Investment
GoalOptions.Text: Secure Board approval and investment for the full-scale deployment of the AI-powered Cloud Waste Identification & Remediation system. Success means demonstrating clear ROI and strategic alignment with financial objectives.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Engineering
GoalOptions.Text: Align the VP Engineering and their teams on the technical roadmap and implementation priorities for the event-driven cloud optimization solution. Success means clear understanding of architectural principles and resource allocation.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Technical Approach
GoalOptions.Text: Validate the technical approach and architectural soundness of the AI-powered system with key stakeholders. Success means confirming the solution's ability to meet non-functional requirements like accuracy, latency, and security.

GoalOptions.Label: Quantify Savings Potential
GoalOptions.Text: Clearly quantify the projected cloud cost savings and operational efficiencies achievable through the system's deployment. Success means stakeholders grasp the financial impact and resource optimization benefits.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Financial Focus
Criteria: Projected ROI for cloud spend reduction is clearly articulated and compelling.
Scalability of cost savings across diverse cloud environments is demonstrated.
Operational expenditure reduction from automated remediation is quantified.
Alignment with overall company financial targets and budget constraints is evident.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Operational Focus
Criteria: Accuracy of AI-driven waste identification is validated with real-world data.
System's ability to integrate securely with major cloud provider APIs is confirmed.
Latency for analysis and recommendation generation meets defined performance SLAs.
Robustness of automated remediation workflows and rollback mechanisms is assured.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic & Risk Focus
Criteria: Solution's contribution to long-term cloud governance and cost control strategy is clear.
Mitigation strategies for potential security risks related to API access are outlined.
Scalability of the event-driven architecture to handle future cloud growth is addressed.
Impact on developer productivity and operational overhead for cloud administrators is minimized.
